topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light travels as a wave with phase and amplitude.
animations: Fade in light wave representation on #000000 background. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate wave front propagation moving from left to right.
Introduce color contrast to show crest and trough. Crest #FF5733, Trough #33C1FF.
Show wave encountering a small aperture.
Visualize bending diffraction pattern behind aperture.

sections.title: Understanding Diffraction: The 'Bending' Phenomenon
animations: Introduce an obstacle with a narrow slit. #FFCC00.
Show waves emerging as circular ripples from slit.

sections.title: The Holographic Recording Process
lecture_lines: A laser beam splits into two paths.
The object beam captures reflected light.
The reference beam provides the phase baseline.
The interference pattern is recorded on film.
This pattern encodes both phase and amplitude.
animations: Display reference object and laser beam. #00FF00.
Show beam splitting into reference and object waves.
Visualize interference pattern on recording plate. #FF00FF.
Show atomic structure of recording medium capturing pattern.
Highlight interference fringes created on the plate.

sections.title: Reconstruction: Decoding the Diffraction Pattern
lecture_lines: Reconstruct by shining the reference beam.
Light diffracts through the recorded pattern.
The ghost image maintains spatial information.
animations: Re-illuminate recorded plate with reference wave. #FFFFFF.
Visualize diffraction revealing original object wave.
Show 3D image appearing in front of viewer. #00FFFF.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Modern applications include security and imaging.
